description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git pack-redundant' command. It sets up git repositories, creates commits and packs, and verifies the behavior of the pack-redundant tool through various test cases involving pack creation, redundancy checks, and cleanup processes.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates a series of commits in a specified git repository, assigning their SHAs to shell variables for use in tests.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack file in the specified repository with objects read from stdin and assigns the pack id to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats the list of pack files extracted from the output of 'git pack-objects' or similar output.
